source: 621 Hanth Island
target: 621 Insula Hanth

source: Ludwig, savoring succulent roasted lamb chops, cast a quick glance at the ancient notebook and the note containing the Love Incantation.
target: Ludwig, succulenta assa agnorum costulas degustans, celeriter intuebatur ad antiquam schedulam et ad notam quae Incantationem Amoris continet.

source: “I can only provide details about the paper’s age, the raw materials, and the manufacturing process.”
target: “Solum possum praebere notitias de aetate chartae, de materia prima, et de processu fabricandi.”

source: The knowledge and concealed content inscribed on it couldn’t be extracted.
target: Scientia et absconditus contentus in eo inscriptus extrahi non potuerunt.

source: “Alright.” Lumian withdrew his hand, his disappointment minimal.
target: “Recte.”

source: He had approached Ludwig with the intention that it didn’t harm asking.
target: Ad Ludwighum accessit, existimans quaerere nullum malum afferre.

source: Finding nothing else of interest, he settled into the recliner, immersing himself in the warm sunlight.
target: Nihil aliud delectabile inveniens, consedit in solio reclinato, se in sole calido immergens.

source: Flipping through the ancient notebook filled with Demon legends,
target: Pervagans per antiquam schedulam, quae fabulis daemonum plena erat,

source: Lumian found it composed entirely in Highlander.
target: Lumian invenit eam totam in linguā Highlander conscriptam esse.

source: Flores, having only attended elementary grammar school, wouldn’t have comprehended it otherwise.
target: Flores, quem solum scholae grammaticae elementariae frequentavit, id aliter non intellexisset.

source: Reading with enthusiasm, as if engrossed in a gripping novel, Lumian discovered that certain legends surpassed even the thrill of contemporary horror stories, sending shivers down his spine.
target: Studio legens, quasi in novam captivam, Lumian invenit certas fabulas etiam excitamentum historiarum horroris temporis hodiernarum superare, tremores per spinam eius efferentes.

source: Occasionally, incantations emerged, some fabricated by the ignorant and subjected to numerous alterations.
target: Interdum incantationes apparuerunt, quarum quaedam ab ignorantibus compositae erant et multis mutationibus subiectae.

source: Others carried a subtle malevolence, bearing a resemblance to Naboredisley.
target: Aliae subtili malevolentia praeditae erant, cum similitudine ad Naboredisley referentes.

source: Lumian refrained from uttering them aloud, silently reciting them instead.
target: Lumian ea non audible proferre utebatur, sed silentio recitabat.

source: The first day of the Berries’ voyage unfolded in tranquil serenity.
target: Primum diem itineris Berries in tranquilla serenitate evolutus est.

source: Late at night, Lumian dreamt of enchanting scenes, weaving into blush-inducing stories that heightened his emotions.
target: Nocte sero, Lumian somniavit de scaenis incantatoriis, fabulas texens quae ruborem excitare et affectus eius augere solebant.

source: Suddenly, Lumian awoke.
target: Subito, Lumian evigilavit.

source: Sunlight filtered through the window curtains, casting a faint glow.
target: Lux solis per cortinas fenestrarum transibat, tenue fulgor afferens.

source: It was 6 a.m.
target: Hora sexta erat.

source: Lying in bed, Lumian experienced a sense of loss.
target: Cubans in lecto, Lumian sensum amissionis experiebatur.

source: He lacked the endurance of an Ascetic in dreams, causing certain scenes to be unusually poignant.
target: Non habebat patientiam asceticorum in somniis, ita ut quaedam scaenae insolitē affectum moverent.

source: Phew… Lumian exhaled, emitting a self-deprecating laugh.
target: Phew… Lumian suspiravit, risum sibi ipsi auto-depressive edens.

source: Almost forgot, this isn’t a boon; it’s a curse.
target: Paene oblitus, hoc non beneficium est; maledictum est.

source: Reverting to a physical state when Termiboros was newly sealed at 6 a.m. every morning brought benefits like fearlessness of serious injuries, no heed of energy consumption, and automatic healing.
target: Rediens ad statum physicum, quo Termiboros omni mane, hora sexta, nuper sigillatus erat, beneficia afferebat, ut impaviditas vulnerum gravium, nullae solliciti de consumptione energiae, et sanatio automatica.

source: Though thoughts of Cordu’s catastrophe and his sister Aurore haunted him with each reset, the initial pain gradually dulled, becoming a bearable numbness after his psychiatric treatment.
target: Quamquam cogitationes de catastropha Cordi et de sorore eius Aurore eum, unicuique refectione vexabant, initialis dolor paulatim attenuebatur, evadens in tolerabilem insensibilitatem post therapiae psychiatricae suae.

source: Occasionally, he felt a dull ache and emptiness.
target: Interdum dolorem lentum et inaniam sentiebat.

source: Lumian rose from bed and drew open the curtains, revealing two contrasting scenes of the azure sea.
target: Lumian ex lecto surrexit et velamina aperuit, duas scaenas contrarias maris caerulei revelans.

source: To the right, a crimson sun had just surfaced on the horizon.
target: Ad dextram, sol ruber modo in horizonte apparuerat.

source: To the left, fog lingered, and waves surged, shrouding the situation 100 meters away.
target: Ad sinistram, nebula manebat et fluctus impetu aggrediebantur, rem centum metris abscondentes.

source: Exiting the master bedroom, Lumian noticed that Lugano was already awake, captivated by the seascape.
target: Exiens ex cubiculo principali, Lumian animadvertit Lugano iam evigilatum esse, a prospectu marino captus.

source: “You’re in a good mood,” Lumian teased.
target: «In bono animo es,» Lumian iocose arridens dixerat.

source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and replied, “It’s my first time in the Berserk Sea. I’m a little excited and woke up early.”
target: Lugano subridens verecunde respondit, «Prima vice in Mari Berserco sum. Paululum excitatus sum et mane evigilavi.»

source: He added, “Besides, if I want to be your interpreter, I have to master Dutanese as soon as possible.”
target: Adiecit, «Praeterea, si interpretus tuus esse volo, Dutanensem quam primum perdiscere debeo.»

source: On the coffee table in the room lay numerous Dutanese books recently purchased by Lumian from Port Colla.
target: In mensā parvā in conclāvī iacebant plures libri Dutanenses, nuper a Lumiano ex Porto Colla emptī.

source: Being a primary trading port for the Southern Continent, Port Colla’s citizens had a practical need to learn Dutanese, resulting in a trend.
target: Cum esset portus mercatorius primārius pro Continente Meridionali, cives Portī Colla necessitātem practicā Dutanense discendī haberent, quā consuetūdō evenit.

source: Lumian easily acquired two sets of teaching materials covering elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels, along with practice materials, thanks to various teaching aids and Dutanese instructors.
target: Lumian facile duas copias materialium docendī consecutus est, quās gradūs elementāri, mediocres, et provectōs complectebantur, una cum materialibus exercitationis, gratias variīs auxiliīs docendī et magistrīs Dutanensis.

source: This was a stark contrast to Port Santa, where obtaining a few barely usable books required considerable effort.
target: Hoc plane contrarium erat ad Portum Santa, ubi paucos lībrōs vix utī liberos obtinere magnam labōrem exigebat.

source: Lumian applauded gently.
target: Lumian leniter plausit.

source: “Not bad.”
target: «Non male.»

source: Lugano pointed towards the foggy sea and explained, “Last night, I heard from a sailor on the ship that many vessels attempted to explore the sea in that direction, but they never returned.
target: Lugano ad mare nebulosum demonstrāns dixit, «Heri nocte, ex nauta in nāve audīvī multae nāves maris in illā partem explorārī conātās esse, sed numquam redierunt.

source: Occasionally, people would spot one of those ships quietly passing by at night with no lights or anyone on the deck.
target: Interdum, hominēs unus ex illīs nāvibus noctū silenti transīre videbantur, sine luminibus nec aliquō homine in ponte.

source: “They say it’s the Berserk Sea. Stick to the safe sea route; attempting unknown routes often leads to unknown and irresistible danger.
target: «Dicunt hoc esse Mare Berserco. Servā iter maritimum tutum; iter ignotum conārī saepe ad perīculum ignōtum atque irresistibile ducit.

source: “See, the sun is rising over there, right? The sea seems calm, but venture beyond the safe route, and we might face a sudden hurricane, a lightning storm, or even get melted by the sun and evaporated. These are tales from sailors; I’m not sure if they’re true.”
target: «Vide, sol illuc oritur, nonne? Mare placidum videtur, sed si extra iter tutum proficiās, fortasse subeāmus subito turbine, fulminōsa tempestate, aut etiam sol liquefieri atque evaporāri; hae sunt fabulae nāutarum, nescio num vera sint.»

source: Lumian nodded and suggested, “Look into more similar rumors.”
target: Lumian annuēns suādet, «Explorā plūra similia rumorēs.»

source: With his employer’s approval, Lugano’s expression brightened, finding a purpose in his work.
target: Patroni consensū, vultus Lugānī illustrātus est, in operē suo prōpositum inveniēns.

source: The voyage through the Berserk Sea proved relatively uneventful.
target: Itinēris per Mare Berserco relative sine rebus eventibus constāvit.

source: Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano managed to avoid causing any disruptions.
target: Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano perturbātiōnēs efficere vitare potuērunt.

source: Occasionally, they witnessed storms capable of city-wide destruction or forest-like lightning.
target: Interdum tempestātēs conspexiērunt, quae totam urbem destruere poterant aut fulgūra silvestria exhibēbant.

source: Sometimes, they noticed the absence of fish throughout the entire sea, creating an eerie silence akin to the legendary Underworld.
target: Aliquando animadvērti sunt carēntia piscum totī marī, quietem ignotam effingentem, similem fabulōso Infernō.

source: Guided by the seasoned captain, first mate, and sailors, the Berries navigated through these regions along the safe sea route.
target: Dūcti ā peritō capitaneō, prīmō nāutice, et nāutīs, Berries has regionēs per iter maritimum tutum secūtī sunt.

source: After a few days, the ocean-venturing steamship reached Hanth Island, the transit port.
target: Post paucos diēs, nāvis vaporāriā oceānica ad Insulām Hanth, portum trānsitus, pervēnit.

source: The crew replenished coal and water, conducted machine maintenance, restocked light beer, and replenished various food supplies over two days.
target: Turma carboṇem et aquam refēcit, machīnārum sustentātiōnem curāvit, cervesiam levem replevit, et varia subsidia alimēntāria per duas diēs restituit.

source: “There doesn’t seem to be any specialties on this island,” Lugano remarked, consulting the travel guide from Port Colla.
target: «Non vidētur in hāc insulā esse specialitātēs,» Lugānō remarkāvit, ducem itinerum ex Porto Colla consulēns.

source: “But due to its strategic geographical location and natural deepwater port, it’s one of the main transit ports controlled by the Feynapotter Kingdom.”
target: «Sed propter situm geogrāficum stratēgicum et naturalem portum altī aquae, hic est ūnus ex portīs trānsitus prīncipālibus a Regnō Feynapotter imperātīs.»

source: Specialties? Does that include Demons? Lumian critiqued silently, producing two gold risots and twirling them in his hand.
target: Specialitātēs? Num hoc Daemōnēs includit?

source: “I’m going to try the local self-brewed wine.”
target: «Vinum locāle, proprie domestice factum, probābo.»

source: He made his way to the port’s largest bar and ordered a glass of thick, pomegranate-colored local red wine, Paha.
target: Ad maximam tabernam in portū iter fēcit et poculum vini rubrī locālī crassī, colōre granatō, Paha, iussit.

source: Lumian struck up a conversation with a few patrons near the bar counter, deliberately approaching one with a local accent.
target: Lumian colloquium incepit cum paucīs clientibus prope mensam tabernae, conscio accedēns ad ūnum cum accentū locālī.

source: “I met a nice chick,” he said with a sly wink and an ambiguous smile.
target: «Mulierem amoenam conveni,» inquit, cum astutā obliquīō et ambigūā risū.

source: “We’re going on a date later—on a quiet night. Can you share a few local horror stories? They don’t have to be well-known, just terrifying enough, preferably with a specific location.
target: Exempli grātiā, if there’s a horrifying tale about an empty house on a certain street, heh heh, I plan to take her there for our date.”

source: The local, his beard dampened with ale, set down his oak beer mug and chuckled.
target: Localis, barba eius cervisiā madida, poculum cervisiāe ex quercū posuit et subrīdens cachinnāvit.

source: “How devious, but I like you! It’s a battle of wits between men and women. For victory, anything goes!”
target: «Quam callidum, sed tē amo! Certāmen ingeniī inter vīrōs et fēminās est. Ad victoriam, quidquid agitur, valeat!»

source: After a brief pause, the local suggested, “You can take her on a date at the edge of the forest outside the city.
target: Post brevem intervallum, localis suādet, «Illam ad conviviā ducere potēs in mārgine silvae extra urbem.

source: You know, a forest at night is always chilling. Besides, there might be more than one Demon lurking in the woods on Hanth Island.
target: Scīs, silva noctū semper formidōsa est. Praeterea, fortasse plus quam ūnus Daemōn in silvīs Insulā Hanth latet.»

source: “As far back as I can remember, the priests have been warning everyone against venturing deep into the forest or even thinking about cutting wood in the middle of the island.
target: «Quo usque meminī, sacerdotēs omnēs monuerunt ne penitus in silvam intrārent aut de lignō secandō in mediā insulā cogitārent.

source: There are many hidden dangers.
target: Multa perīcula occulta sunt.

source: “What kind of dangers, you ask? The priests never specify, but someone always tells me about some random person encountering a Demon with goat horns and an unpleasant sulfuric smell in the forest.
target: «Qualia perīcula, quæris? Sacerdotēs numquam specificant, sed aliquis semper mihi narrat de quadam persona fortuitā, quae Daemōnem cum cornibus caprārum et odōre sulphureō infestō in silvā obvenit.

source: As for those who claim to have seen the Demon with their own eyes, it’s said that they all met their demise—for some unknown reason.
target: Quoad eōs qui Daemōnem propriīs oculīs vidisse affirmant, fertur eōs omnēs interitum subīisse—causa quacumque ignōta.

source: “How about that? No woman isn’t afraid of a Demon. Well, except my wife. She’s even scarier than a Demon!”
target: «Quid de hoc? Nulla fēmina Daemōnem non timet. Bene, nisi uxōr mea; ipsa etiam terribilius Daemōnis est!»

source: Have the Demon stories on Hanth Island evolved to such an extent?
target: Fueruntne fabulae Daemōnum in Insulā Hanth evolutae ad tam altum gradum?

source: It resembles the legend of the Montsouris ghost, but encountering a Montsouris ghost does result in the death of an entire family.
target: Similitudinem habet legendāri phantasmātī Montsouris, sed congressus cum phantasmā Montsouris totam familiam interficit.

source: Hanth Island doesn’t have such an obvious characteristic… Lumian raised his glass of red wine, toasting the local before saying, “Though I’m quite charming, I doubt any chick would be willing to follow me to the edge of the forest outside the city on our first date, especially at night.
target: Insulā Hanth talem proprietātem manifestam non habet… Lumian poculum vini rubrī levātum habēns, localem ad glorificandum allocūtus, antequam dīceret, «Quamquam elegans sum, dubitus habeō quin quaedam puella mē sequi volat ad limitem silvae extra urbem in nōstro primo conventū, praesertim noctū.

source: Even if she’s not afraid of me doing harm, she might worry that I’m a criminal with a penchant for harming young girls.
target: Etiam sī non timet ne laedam, fortasse sollicītatūr erit quō me criminatōrem esse, cui inclinātiō est ad laedendās puellās juveniles.

source: How about this: Is there a legend of a serial killer? Ideally, one that haunts the city.
target: Quid de hoc: num legendā de caede seriatim perpetrātā existit? Optime, qua urbē infestātur.

source: Drawing from Aurore’s grimoires and the information gathered in recent months, Lumian discerned that Sequence 9 of the Demon pathway was Criminal, Sequence 8 was Coldblooded, and Sequence 7 was Serial Killer.
target: Ex librīs magicis Aurore et informatione his proximīs mēnsibus collectā, Lumian intellexit Sequenciam IX viā Daemonica esse Criminalem, Sequenciam VIII esse Frigidam, et Sequenciam VII esse Homicidam Seriatim.

source: The name of Sequence 7, Serial Killer, indicated that Beyonders, regardless of their grasp of the acting method, would actively or passively engage in serial killings.
target: Nōmen Sequenciae VII, Homicidā Seriatim, indicābat Beyonders, quocumque modum agendī non plene comprehendentēs, sive active sive passive in caedibus seriatim implicārī.

source: Although the Demon on Hanth Island had clearly surpassed Sequence 7 and evolved beyond the Serial Killer stage, Lumian wondered whether, as a high-ranking individual who had progressed through the ranks, it retained certain preferences acquired during its Serial Killer phase.
target: Quamquam Daemōn in Insulā Hanth manifestē Sequenciam VII superāverat et ultra statum Homicidī Seriatim evolverat, Lumian mirābātur utrum, ut individuum in altissimum gradu profectum, quaedam praeferentiās ex tempore Homicidī Seriatim conservāret.

source: Intelligent beings, be they human or of a certain creature, tended to maintain certain desires if not deliberately restrained or controlled.
target: Entia intelligenta, sive humana sive ex certo genere, certos dēsideriās servare solebant, nisi conscienter cohibērentur.

source: Just as humans might occasionally indulge in a drink, Demons might occasionally engage in serial killings.
target: Sicut hominēs interdum in potione delectārī possunt, ita Daemōnēs interdum in caedibus seriatim versārī possunt.

source: Moreover, if Naboredisley’s commission wasn’t concocted merely for a verbal agreement, the Demon of Hanth Island or its descendants should be concealed among humans.
target: Praeterea, sī commissio Naboredisley non solum ex verbālī pacto constitūtā esset, Daemōn Insulā Hanth aut eius postērī inter hominēs celārī dēbent.

source: The bearded local pondered for a moment before responding, “There haven’t been any serial killers. In a small place like ours, if serial murders were happening, everyone in the city would know.”
target: Localis barbātus paulisper meditātus est antequam responderet, «Nullī homicidae seriatim exstitērunt. In parvō locō ut nōstrō, sī caedes seriatim evenirent, omnēs in urbē scīrent.»

source: He paused, then added, “But what if someone goes missing in the forest outside the city every year? Would that count?”
target: Pausāvit, deinde addidit, «Sed quid sī aliquis quotanniē in silvā extra urbem evanescat? Num id existimetur?»

source: In Trier, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony managed to gather sufficient information about Moran Avigny, the current Minister of Industry.
target: In Treverīs, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony satis notitiā de Moran Avigny, ministro industriae praesentis, collegērunt.

source: This information included a color photograph.
target: Haec notitiā complēctēbat imaginem coloris.

source: In the picture, Moran Avigny displayed a striking resemblance to an Intisian.
target: In imagine, Moran Avigny conspicuam similitudinem cum Intisianō ostendēbat.

source: Despite his age, he exuded an air of elegance.
target: Non obstānte aetāte, aerem elegantiae diffundēbat.

source: In his late sixties, his once-black hair had transitioned into a distinguished gray.
target: In annīs suis sexāgēsimīs proximīs, capillī eius, olim nigrī, in griseum dignum transierant.

source: Refined facial features and dark gray eyes added to his overall presence, with the wrinkles on his face highlighting the passage of time.
target: Rationēs faciei elegantēs et oculī obscurigrīs ad praeśentiam eius addidērunt, cum rugīs in fācie tempus transitum evidenter monstrantibus.

source: “Dark gray eyes are rare in Intis…” Franca sighed.
target: «Oculī obscurigrīs in Intis rārī sunt...» Franca suspiravit.

source: Mid-sentence, she abruptly halted.
target: In mediō dictī, repente cessāvit.

source: Another individual with dark-gray eyes in Intis crossed her mind—Demoness of Black Clarice.
target: Aliud individuum cum oculīs obscurigrīs in Intis illī in mentem vēnit—Daemonissa Nigrae Clarice.
